definition.measurement_definition: Determine if the pretreatment clinical record contains any evidence that a magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scan was performed for the patient.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'No' if there is no documentation of an MRI being performed.
definition.name: imaging_mri_performed

definition.description: Maximum Standardized Uptake Value (SUVmax) measured via PET imaging.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the highest reported standardized uptake value (SUVmax) for the primary tumor or most metabolic lesion from the pretreatment PET scan.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no numeric SUVmax value is documented in the record.
definition.name: imaging_pet_suv_max

definition.description: The specific type or class of immunotherapy agent administered to the patient.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the mentioned type of immunotherapy from the pretreatment record, specifically looking for terms such as checkpoint blockade, PD-1 inhibitors, or PD-L1 inhibitors.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'Not documented' if no immunotherapy type is mentioned.
definition.name: immunotherapy_type

definition.description: The number of puffs of inhaler medication administered per dose.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric value representing the number of inhaler puffs per administration from the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no numeric dosage is documented.
definition.name: inhaler_usage_dosage

definition.description: Presence of abnormal contrast enhancement within the orbital region.
definition.measurement_definition: Determine if abnormal contrast enhancement is identified within the orbit (including optic nerves, extraocular muscles, and orbital fat) from post-contrast imaging reports.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the orbital region is not evaluated or if enhancement is not mentioned in the report.
definition.name: intra_orbital_enhancement

definition.description: Presence of a mass within the orbital cavity.
definition.measurement_definition: Determine from imaging reports (e.g., MRI, CT) whether an intra-orbital mass or abnormal orbital enhancement is explicitly identified.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the orbits are not evaluated or if documentation is insufficient to determine the presence or absence of a mass.
definition.name: intra_orbital_mass

definition.description: Presence of bleeding within the cranial cavity.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether intracranial hemorrhage (including intraparenchymal, subdural, or epidural hemorrhage) is identified on brain imaging reports.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if imaging documentation is missing or does not explicitly evaluate for hemorrhage.
definition.name: intracranial_hemorrhage

definition.description: Presence of jugular venous distention on physical examination.
definition.measurement_definition: Determine if jugular venous distention (JVD) is documented as present or absent in the pretreatment physical examination or clinical notes.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the documentation is absent or ambiguous.
definition.name: jugular_venous_distention_presence

definition.description: The mutation status of the KEAP1 gene.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the mutation status of the KEAP1 gene from the molecular pathology or genomic testing section of the patient record.
definition.missing_value_rule: If KEAP1 status is not documented or cannot be determined, record as null.
definition.name: keap1_status

definition.description: The percentage of tumor cell nuclei that are positive for the Ki-67 protein, representing the proliferative growth fraction of the tumor.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical percentage associated with Ki-67 (or MIB-1) from the immunohistochemistry (IHC) or pathology report. If the value is reported as an approximation (e.g., '~30%'), extract the number as a float.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the Ki-67 proliferation index is not documented or the documentation is too ambiguous to derive a numerical value.
definition.name: ki67_proliferation_index

definition.description: Presence of knee osteoarthritis at pretreatment.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if knee osteoarthritis is documented as a diagnosis in the patient's medical history, problem list, or clinical notes.
definition.missing_value_rule: If no mention of knee osteoarthritis is found in the patient record, the value is recorded as null.
definition.name: knee_osteoarthritis_presence

definition.description: Indication of whether the patient has any known allergies to medications.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the patient's drug allergy status. Map 'NKDA', 'No known drug allergies', or 'No drug allergies reported' to 'No'. Map any documented specific drug allergy or an affirmative statement of drug allergies to 'Yes'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if allergy status is not documented.
definition.name: known_drug_allergies

definition.description: The proportion of mutant KRAS G12C alleles relative to the total number of alleles at that locus, typically derived from next-generation sequencing.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the Variant Allele Frequency (VAF) specifically for the KRAS G12C mutation from molecular profiling or next-generation sequencing (NGS) reports. This is typically reported as a percentage.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the KRAS G12C mutation is not detected (wild-type), not tested, or if the VAF is not numerically specified.
definition.name: kras_g12c_variant_allele_frequency

definition.description: Serum lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) level.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical value of the serum lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) measurement from the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if LDH is not documented or the value is ambiguous.
definition.name: ldh_level

definition.description: Presence of contrast enhancement in the leptomeninges on brain imaging.
definition.measurement_definition: Determine if contrast-enhanced brain MRI reports indicate the presence or absence of abnormal leptomeningeal enhancement.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no brain MRI with contrast is available or if the report does not mention the leptomeninges.
definition.name: leptomeningeal_enhancement_presence

definition.description: Whether lesions are present in the patient.
definition.measurement_definition: Determine if the pretreatment patient record (including physical examinations, imaging reports, or diagnostic notes) indicates the presence of lesions.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the record does not mention lesions or if the documentation is too ambiguous to determine presence or absence.
definition.name: lesion_presence

definition.description: The maximum linear dimension of the lesion.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical value of the lesion's largest dimension in centimeters. If a range is provided, extract the upper limit.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent missing or ambiguous documentation as null.
definition.name: lesion_size

definition.description: The sequential order of the therapy regimen currently being administered or the most recent regimen attempted for the target condition.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the line of therapy designated in the pretreatment record (e.g., 'first line', 'second line', 'third-line').
definition.missing_value_rule: If the line of therapy is not documented or is ambiguous, represent as null.
definition.name: line_of_therapy

definition.description: Whether the patient is receiving lipid-lowering therapy.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the presence of lipid-lowering medications (e.g., statins, fibrates, bile acid sequestrants, PCSK9 inhibitors) from the pretreatment medication list or clinical notes.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if there is no mention of lipid-lowering medication use or a specific denial of such therapy.
definition.name: lipid_lowering_therapy_use

definition.description: The daily dose of lisinopril administered to the patient.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric value of the lisinopril dose in milligrams (mg) from the patient's medication list or clinical notes.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if lisinopril is not mentioned or the dose is not specified.
definition.name: lisinopril_dose

definition.description: The overall qualitative clinical status of liver function.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the reported status of liver function from the clinical record; documentation such as 'wnl' (within normal limits) or 'normal' should be mapped to 'Normal', while mentions of liver dysfunction, impairment, or abnormal liver tests should be mapped to 'Abnormal'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no assessment of liver function is documented.
definition.name: liver_function

definition.description: Presence of metastatic disease in the liver.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether imaging reports (such as CT, MRI, or PET/CT) or pathology reports identify metastatic lesions in the liver or explicitly state the absence of liver metastases.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the liver is not mentioned or the presence/absence of metastasis is not documented in the record.
definition.name: liver_metastasis_presence

definition.description: The patient's residential living arrangement and household composition.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the patient's residential arrangement from the social history or relevant notes, categorizing whether the patient lives alone, with a spouse/partner, with a child, or in another arrangement (e.g., other relatives or institutional care).
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the living situation is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: living_situation

definition.description: The specific lobe of the lung that was surgically removed during a lobectomy procedure.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the lung lobe specified as being removed in the surgical history, radiology reports, or pathology reports (e.g., 'right lower lobectomy' maps to 'Right Lower Lobe').
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no lobectomy is documented or if the specific lobe removed is not identified.
definition.name: lobectomy_type

definition.description: Findings from lung auscultation during the physical examination.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the described lung sounds or the absence of abnormal sounds (e.g., 'clear', 'wheezes', 'rales') from the respiratory/lung examination section of the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if lung auscultation findings are not documented.
definition.name: lung_auscultation_findings

definition.description: The histological subtype of the primary lung cancer.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the histological type of the lung cancer (e.g., adenocarcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, large-cell carcinoma) from pathology reports or diagnostic assessments. If only the broad category 'non-small cell lung cancer' (NSCLC) is specified without a subtype, extract that as the histology.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'Unknown' if histology is not documented in the record.
definition.name: lung_cancer_histology

definition.description: The overall clinical or pathologic stage of the patient's lung cancer.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the overall stage of lung cancer as a Roman numeral. Map sub-stages I and IA/IB to 'I', and sub-stages IIA/IIB to 'II'. Extract IIIA, IIIB, and IV as specified.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the stage is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: lung_cancer_stage

definition.description: Presence of a medical diagnosis of lung disease.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the patient record contains a diagnosis of any lung-related disease (e.g., COPD, asthma, interstitial lung disease, etc.).
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'Absent' if no lung disease diagnosis is documented.
definition.name: lung_disease_diagnosis

definition.description: Morphological description of the lung mass margins and shape.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the descriptive term characterizing the morphology (e.g., spiculated, smooth, lobulated) of the lung mass from the radiologic report.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no morphological descriptor is provided.
definition.name: lung_mass_morphology

definition.description: Maximum standardized uptake value (SUVmax) of the primary lung mass on PET/CT imaging.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric SUVmax value specifically associated with the primary lung mass (e.g., right lower lobe lesion) from the PET/CT radiology report.
definition.missing_value_rule: If the SUVmax for the lung mass is not documented or is ambiguous, represent as null.
definition.name: lung_mass_suvmax

definition.description: Whether lymph node dissection was conducted during the surgical procedure.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract from the operative report or pathology record whether lymph node dissection (LND) was performed.
definition.missing_value_rule: If documentation is absent or ambiguous, represent as 'Not Performed'.
definition.name: lymph_node_dissection_status

definition.description: The total number of lymph nodes containing metastatic carcinoma.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the number of lymph nodes identified as containing metastatic carcinoma from the surgical pathology report.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no lymph nodes were sampled or if the count of positive nodes is not specified.
definition.name: lymph_node_metastasis_count

definition.description: The presence or absence of lymphadenopathy, typically identified via radiographic imaging or physical examination.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if lymphadenopathy is documented. 'Absent' is indicated by phrases such as 'no lymphadenopathy', 'no enlarged lymph nodes', or 'lymph nodes within normal size limits'. 'Present' is indicated by phrases such as 'bulky lymphadenopathy', 'enlarged lymph nodes', or 'lymphadenopathy present'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no mention of lymph node size or lymphadenopathy status is found in the record.
definition.name: lymphadenopathy_status

definition.description: The TNM M-stage indicating whether the cancer has metastasized to distant sites.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the M-stage value (e.g., M0 or M1) from the TNM staging description provided in the pretreatment clinical documentation.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the M-stage is not explicitly documented.
definition.name: m_stage

definition.description: Whether a mediastinal lymph node dissection was performed during the surgical procedure.
definition.measurement_definition: Search the operative report or surgical summary for explicit mention that a mediastinal lymph node dissection was performed.
definition.missing_value_rule: If the record contains no mention of mediastinal lymph node dissection or sampling, the value is null.
definition.name: mediastinal_lymph_node_dissection_performed

definition.description: Presence or absence of mediastinal lymph node involvement, characterized by metastasis or suspicious lymphadenopathy.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the pretreatment record indicates the presence (Positive) or absence (Negative) of mediastinal lymph node involvement. Evidence includes radiology reports citing 'mediastinal lymphadenopathy', 'enlarged mediastinal nodes', 'nodal involvement (N1, N2, N3)', or pathology reports confirming 'metastatic carcinoma' in mediastinal nodes. Status is 'Negative' if nodes are described as 'normal', 'not enlarged', or 'negative for metastatic carcinoma'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if mediastinal lymph node status is not documented or is described as unknown.
definition.name: mediastinal_lymph_node_status

definition.description: Whether the patient is prescribed calcium carbonate medication.
definition.measurement_definition: Search the medication list and clinical history for 'calcium carbonate' or 'calcium supplement'. If either is documented, extract 'Yes'; otherwise, extract 'No'.
definition.missing_value_rule: If the medication list is absent or there is no mention of calcium carbonate or calcium supplements, represent as 'No'.
definition.name: medication_calcium_carbonate

definition.description: Patient exposure to the chemotherapy agent cisplatin.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient has received cisplatin (generic) or Platinol (brand name). This includes records of completed cycles, administration in the history of present illness, or listed chemotherapy regimens.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'No' if the medication is not mentioned or if there is no evidence of administration in the provided records.
definition.name: medication_cisplatin

definition.description: Patient's use of denosumab, a bone-modifying agent used for skeletal-related event prophylaxis.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the patient was prescribed or initiated on denosumab within the pretreatment records.
definition.missing_value_rule: If denosumab is not mentioned or no evidence of its use is documented, represent as 'No'.
definition.name: medication_denosumab

definition.description: Presence of dexamethasone medication use.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify whether the patient is prescribed or taking dexamethasone by reviewing the medication list, assessment, and treatment plan sections of the patient record.
definition.missing_value_rule: If dexamethasone is not explicitly listed in the medications or mentioned in the clinical notes, represent as 'No'.
definition.name: medication_dexamethasone

definition.description: Whether the patient received a KRAS G12C inhibitor medication pretreatment.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract 'Yes' if the pretreatment record indicates the administration of a KRAS G12C inhibitor (e.g., sotorasib, adagrasib); otherwise extract 'No'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'No' if the medication is not documented or documentation is ambiguous.
definition.name: medication_g12c_inhibitor

definition.description: Indicates whether the patient has received gemcitabine medication prior to the baseline assessment.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient was administered or prescribed gemcitabine (including the brand name Gemzar) as part of their systemic therapy regimen from the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'No' if there is no documentation of gemcitabine administration.
definition.name: medication_gemcitabine

definition.description: Indicates whether the patient is currently prescribed or taking lisinopril.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if 'lisinopril' is explicitly listed in the medications section or mentioned as a current treatment in the clinical notes.
definition.missing_value_rule: If lisinopril is not mentioned in the medication lists or clinical text, the value is 'No'.
definition.name: medication_lisinopril

definition.description: Whether the patient is receiving a MET inhibitor medication.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the patient is prescribed or receiving any MET inhibitor (e.g., capmatinib, tepotinib) according to the pretreatment medication lists, pharmacy records, or clinical notes.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the documentation is absent or too ambiguous to determine the presence or absence of MET inhibitor use.
definition.name: medication_met_inhibitor

definition.description: Whether the patient is taking oxycodone.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if oxycodone is listed in the patient's medication list or documented as being used for pain management within the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: If the medication list is provided but oxycodone is not mentioned, represent as 'No'. If no medication information is provided in the record, represent as null.
definition.name: medication_oxycodone

definition.description: Whether the patient has previously received pemetrexed (Alimta) chemotherapy.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the patient's medical record indicates the administration of pemetrexed or Alimta, often found in chemotherapy regimens (e.g., 'cis-Alimta', 'cisplatin-pemetrexed').
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'No' if there is no mention of the medication in the record.
definition.name: medication_pemetrexed

definition.description: Presence of thickening of the meninges as identified on neuroimaging.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether meningeal thickening is reported as present or absent within the extra-axial structures or impression section of the pretreatment neuroimaging reports.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the report does not mention the meninges or if the status is described ambiguously.
definition.name: meningeal_thickening

definition.description: The amplification status of the MET gene in tumor tissue.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the MET amplification status from the molecular profiling or NGS report. Classify as 'Amplified' if the report indicates 'amplified', 'gain', or a high copy number; classify as 'Negative' if the report indicates 'not detected', 'wild-type', or no amplification.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if MET amplification status or copy number is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: met_amplification_status

definition.description: Patient-level assessment of whether there was a metabolic response to treatment, typically determined by functional imaging.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the presence or absence of a documented metabolic response to therapy (e.g., via PET scan) from the pretreatment or treatment-monitoring records.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no information regarding metabolic response is documented.
definition.name: metabolic_response

definition.description: The anatomical location of metastatic disease in a patient.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify the anatomical sites of distant metastasis as documented in radiology reports (such as CT, MRI, or PET scans) or oncology assessment notes.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no metastatic locations are documented or if the patient is explicitly noted to have no distant metastases.
definition.name: metastasis_location

definition.description: Whether the patient was administered morphine prior to treatment.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract 'Yes' if the patient record indicates the use or administration of morphine (e.g., for pain control); otherwise extract 'No'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if morphine administration is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: morphine_administered

definition.description: Presence of hyperintensity on T2-FLAIR MRI sequences.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient's medical records, specifically MRI reports, indicate the presence or absence of T2-FLAIR hyperintensities.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no documentation regarding T2-FLAIR hyperintensity is found in the patient record.
definition.name: mri_flair_hyperintensity_presence

definition.description: Microsatellite instability (MSI) status of the tumor.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the MSI status from the molecular pathology or Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) report. Values such as 'Stable', 'MSS', 'Microsatellite Stable' map to 'Stable'; values such as 'High', 'MSI-H', 'MSI-High' map to 'High'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if MSI status is not documented or the result is ambiguous.
definition.name: msi_status

definition.description: Presence of mucositis (inflammation and ulceration of the mucous membranes) prior to treatment.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether mucositis is documented as being present or absent in the pretreatment clinical records.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the clinical records do not explicitly mention the presence or absence of mucositis.
definition.name: mucositis_presence

definition.description: Presence of myelosuppression at pretreatment.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify whether myelosuppression is documented as present or absent in the pretreatment clinical record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if myelosuppression is not mentioned or documentation is ambiguous.
definition.name: myelosuppression

definition.description: The presence of a documented history of myocardial infarction.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if there is any documented diagnosis, medical history entry, or clinical note stating the patient has experienced a myocardial infarction prior to the pretreatment period.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the medical record contains no mention of myocardial infarction or the documentation is ambiguous.
definition.name: myocardial_infarction_presence

definition.description: The regional lymph node stage (N stage) of the lung cancer as part of the TNM classification system.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the N-stage identifier (e.g., N0, N1, N2, N3) from the cancer staging documentation. If reported as pN or cN, extract the N value.
definition.missing_value_rule: If the N-stage is not documented or is ambiguous, represent as null.
definition.name: n_stage

definition.description: Napsin A expression as determined by immunohistochemical (IHC) staining of tumor cells.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the result of Napsin A immunohistochemistry from the pathology report.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if Napsin A staining was not performed or the result is not documented.
definition.name: napsin_a_expression

definition.description: The severity of nausea experienced by the patient, typically graded using the Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) or Patient-Reported Outcomes version of CTCAE (PRO-CTCAE).
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric grade of nausea severity (1-4) from the patient record. If documented as a range (e.g., 'grade 1-2'), extract the maximum value of the range. Map descriptive terms to numeric grades: Mild = 1, Moderate = 2, Severe = 3, Life-threatening/Disabling = 4.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if nausea is not mentioned, is explicitly documented as absent, or if the severity is not specified.
definition.name: nausea_severity

definition.description: Presence of necrotic fluid in the clinical specimen or anatomical site.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify any mention of necrotic fluid in the patient's pretreatment records; categorize as 'Present' if identified as present or obvious, and 'Absent' otherwise.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'Absent' if necrotic fluid is not mentioned or documentation is ambiguous.
definition.name: necrotic_fluid_presence

definition.description: Presence of neurological symptoms in the pretreatment record.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient's record indicates the presence of neurological symptoms, including mentions of 'new neurologic changes', 'neurologic compromise', or 'neurologic symptoms develop'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'Absent' if there is no mention of neurological symptoms or if they are explicitly denied.
definition.name: neurological_symptoms_presence

definition.description: The ratio of the absolute neutrophil count to the absolute lymphocyte count, used as a marker of systemic inflammation.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the explicitly reported neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR) from laboratory results. If the ratio is not explicitly provided but absolute neutrophil and lymphocyte counts are available in the CBC differential, the value is the quotient of absolute neutrophils divided by absolute lymphocytes.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if neither the NLR nor both necessary components (absolute neutrophils and absolute lymphocytes) are documented.
definition.name: neutrophil_to_lymphocyte_ratio

definition.description: Presence of night sweats as a systemic symptom.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the pretreatment record documents the occurrence of night sweats or general sweats.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the documentation is absent or ambiguous.
definition.name: night_sweats

definition.description: Whether the patient has a diagnosis of Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC).
definition.measurement_definition: Determine if the patient record contains a diagnosis of Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC). This includes explicit mentions of 'NSCLC' or the identification of its histological subtypes such as adenocarcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, or large cell carcinoma.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'Absent' if no diagnosis of NSCLC or its subtypes is documented or if the documentation is ambiguous.
definition.name: nsclc_diagnosis

definition.description: The New York Heart Association (NYHA) functional classification of heart failure.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the reported NYHA class (I, II, III, or IV) from the patient's pretreatment clinical notes, typically associated with descriptions of dyspnea and exercise tolerance.
definition.missing_value_rule: Report as null if no NYHA class is documented or if the documentation is too ambiguous to assign a specific class.
definition.name: nyha_class

definition.description: The professional status of the patient's occupation.
definition.measurement_definition: Categorize the patient's occupation as 'Professional' if they have a professional job title (e.g., healthcare provider, engineer, educator), otherwise categorize as 'Other'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'Unknown' if the occupation is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: occupation

definition.description: The current clinical management phase of a patient under oncology care.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the stated status of oncology management from the pretreatment record, identifying whether the patient is undergoing active treatment, is in a routine follow-up or surveillance phase, or is not under oncology management.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent absent or ambiguous documentation as 'Unknown'.
definition.name: oncology_management_status

definition.description: Whether the patient is using or has been prescribed ondansetron as an antiemetic.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if ondansetron is listed in the patient's current medications, mentioned as being continued in progress notes, or prescribed in the treatment plan for nausea/vomiting prophylaxis or treatment.
definition.missing_value_rule: Absent documentation or lack of mention of ondansetron in the medication list and plan is represented as 'No'.
definition.name: ondansetron_use

definition.description: Presence of abnormal contrast enhancement of the optic chiasm on MRI.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the post-contrast T1-weighted imaging report indicates the presence or absence of abnormal enhancement of the optic chiasm.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the optic chiasm is not mentioned or the documentation regarding its enhancement is ambiguous.
definition.name: optic_chiasm_enhancement

definition.description: Presence of abnormal contrast enhancement of the optic nerves on neuroimaging.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the radiology report mentions 'abnormal enhancement' or 'enhancement' of the optic nerves. 'No abnormal enhancement' or 'unremarkable' optic nerves indicate absence; 'abnormal enhancement' or 'enhancing' optic nerves indicate presence.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the optic nerves are not mentioned or if the report does not specify the presence or absence of enhancement.
definition.name: optic_nerve_enhancement

definition.description: The qualitative appearance of the orbital fat as described in neuroimaging reports.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the described status of the orbital fat from the radiology report (e.g., 'within normal limits', 'normal', 'abnormal', or descriptions of stranding/infiltration).
definition.missing_value_rule: If orbital fat appearance is not mentioned or is ambiguous, represent as null.
definition.name: orbital_fat_appearance

definition.description: The presence or absence of organ enlargement (organomegaly) in the patient.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether organomegaly is documented as present or absent from the pretreatment clinical records, including radiology reports and physical examination notes.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if organomegaly is not mentioned in the documentation.
definition.name: organomegaly_presence

definition.description: Presence of osteoarthritis at the time of the pretreatment record.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if osteoarthritis (OA) is listed in the patient's past medical history, comorbidity list, or mentioned within the musculoskeletal review of systems (e.g., 'osteoarthritis of knees', 'mild knee OA pain').
definition.missing_value_rule: If osteoarthritis is not documented or is explicitly denied, it is represented as 'Absent'.
definition.name: osteoarthritis_presence

definition.description: Presence of osteopenia as diagnosed by clinical record or DEXA scan.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if osteopenia is explicitly documented in the pretreatment medical records, typically found in the comorbidities section, diagnostic reports, or noted as a result of a DEXA scan.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if there is no mention of osteopenia or DEXA scan results in the record.
definition.name: osteopenia

definition.description: The percentage of hemoglobin saturated with oxygen (SpO2).
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical percentage value of oxygen saturation (SpO2) from the vital signs section of the record. If the value is reported with modifiers such as 'RA' (room air) or a specific flow rate of supplemental oxygen, extract only the numeric percentage.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if oxygen saturation is not documented or if the value is ambiguous.
definition.name: oxygen_saturation

definition.description: Whether the patient is using supplemental oxygen therapy.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract as 'Yes' if the pretreatment record indicates the patient is receiving supplemental oxygen (e.g., 'on oxygen', 'O2 therapy', 'supplemental oxygen'); otherwise 'No'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if documentation is absent or ambiguous.
definition.name: oxygen_therapy_use

definition.description: The immunohistochemical expression status of the p40 protein in tumor cells.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the result of p40 immunohistochemistry (IHC) staining from the pathology report. Categorize as 'Positive' if the report indicates any form of positivity (e.g., 'Positive', 'Strong nuclear positivity', 'p40+', 'Diffuse nuclear') and 'Negative' if the report indicates negativity (e.g., 'Negative', 'p40-', 'Excludes squamous differentiation').
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if p40 immunohistochemistry is not performed or the result is not mentioned in the record.
definition.name: p40_expression

definition.description: The administered dose of paclitaxel per cycle.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical value of the paclitaxel dose from the chemotherapy regimen or administration records, typically reported in mg/m^2.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the dose is not documented or cannot be determined from the record.
definition.name: paclitaxel_dose

definition.description: Patient-reported grade of pain severity.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric grade (0-4) for pain severity as reported by the patient using the PRO-CTCAE instrument, where 0 = None, 1 = Mild, 2 = Moderate, 3 = Severe, and 4 = Life-threatening or disabling.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no pain severity grade from the PRO-CTCAE scale is documented.
definition.name: pain_severity

definition.description: Patient's status regarding the receipt or designation of palliative care.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the pretreatment record indicates the patient is receiving palliative care, has a palliative care consultation, or is documented as having a palliative care status.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if there is no mention of palliative care status in the record.
definition.name: palliative_care_status

definition.description: Whether the patient has expressed or documented specific medical treatment preferences or advance directives in the pretreatment record.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the record contains any mention of advance directives, living wills, DNR (Do Not Resuscitate) orders, DNI (Do Not Intubate) orders, or explicitly stated patient preferences regarding medical care.
definition.missing_value_rule: If no documentation of patient wishes is present in the record, represent as 'Not Documented'.
definition.name: patient_wishes

definition.description: The percentage of viable tumor cells showing membranous and/or cytoplasmic PD-L1 staining, known as the Tumor Proportion Score (TPS).
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric percentage value of the PD-L1 Tumor Proportion Score (TPS) from the pathology or oncology record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the PD-L1 TPS is not documented, reported as not performed, or listed as pending.
definition.name: pd_l1_tps

definition.description: The numeric dose of pembrolizumab administered to the patient.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric value of the pembrolizumab dose administered per dose cycle from the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no numeric dose is documented or if the documentation is ambiguous.
definition.name: pembrolizumab_dose

definition.description: The grade of peripheral neuropathy, representing the severity of nerve damage often induced by chemotherapy.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical grade of peripheral neuropathy (e.g., 'Grade 1', '2/4') from the oncology assessment, progress notes, or patient-reported outcome tools such as PRO-CTCAE. If only a descriptive term is provided (e.g., 'Mild', 'Moderate', 'Severe') and mapped to a grade in the same note, extract the numeric grade.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent missing, not mentioned, or ambiguous grade documentation as null.
definition.name: peripheral_neuropathy_grade

definition.description: Presence of edema surrounding the tumor as identified on radiographic imaging.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the pretreatment imaging records explicitly state the presence or absence of peritumoral (surrounding) edema.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if edema is not mentioned or if the documentation is too ambiguous to determine presence or absence.
definition.name: peritumoral_edema

definition.description: Presence of abnormal signal intensity in the white matter surrounding the cerebral ventricles on neuroimaging.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the presence or absence of 'periventricular signal abnormality' or 'periventricular white matter signal changes' from the radiology findings or impression.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the radiology report does not mention periventricular signal intensity or if the documentation is ambiguous.
definition.name: periventricular_signal_abnormality

definition.description: Phosphorylation status of the MET receptor.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the reported status of phospho-MET (p-MET) from pathology or molecular pathology reports, typically recorded as positive or negative.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if phospho-MET status is not documented, not tested, or reported ambiguously.
definition.name: phospho_met_status

definition.description: Presence of PI3K pathway activation, typically identified through molecular profiling of the PIK3CA gene.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the status of PI3K pathway activation from molecular pathology or Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) reports. The feature is 'Activated' if the report identifies activating mutations in PIK3CA (e.g., H1047R, E545K) or explicitly states 'PI3K pathway activation'. The feature is 'Not Activated' if the report explicitly states that no activating PIK3CA mutations were detected or that the pathway is not activated.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the PI3K pathway status is not documented or the report is ambiguous.
definition.name: pi3k_pathway_activation

definition.description: Presence of abnormal enhancement in the pituitary gland on post-contrast imaging.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the radiology report describes 'abnormal enhancement' within the pituitary gland. If the report states 'no abnormal enhancement' or describes only normal physiological enhancement, the value is 'Absent'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the pituitary gland is not mentioned or if the enhancement status is not documented.
definition.name: pituitary_gland_enhancement

definition.description: Assessment of the signal intensity of the pituitary gland as observed on neuroimaging.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the radiologist's description of the pituitary gland signal from the imaging report. Categorize as 'Normal' if the report states the signal is normal or if there is no abnormal enhancement/signal identified. Categorize as 'Abnormal' if any abnormal signal intensity, abnormal enhancement, or pathology is noted within the pituitary gland.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the pituitary gland signal is not mentioned or the documentation is insufficient to determine normality.
definition.name: pituitary_gland_signal

definition.description: The size of the pituitary gland, typically measured as the maximum craniocaudal height.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the maximum height of the pituitary gland in millimeters. If a numerical measurement is unavailable but the gland is described as 'normal size', this qualitative assessment should be preserved as a fallback.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the pituitary gland size is not mentioned or cannot be determined from the record.
definition.name: pituitary_gland_size

definition.description: the number of platelets per microliter of blood, reported in thousands (k/uL)
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric value for platelets (Plt) from the Complete Blood Count (CBC) in the pretreatment record. Report the value in thousands per microliter (k/uL); for example, if the value is 210,000/uL, extract 210.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the platelet count is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: platelet_count

definition.description: The presence and qualitative volume of fluid accumulation in the pleural space.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the descriptive status of pleural effusion from the most recent imaging reports (e.g., CT, PET/CT, Chest X-ray) or clinical notes. Map 'no pleural effusion' or 'none' to 'Absent', and qualitative descriptors such as 'small', 'moderate', or 'large' to their respective categories.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if there is no mention of pleural effusion or if the documentation is too ambiguous to categorize.
definition.name: pleural_effusion

definition.description: Indicates whether the patient has a diagnosis of pneumonia.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify the presence of a pneumonia diagnosis, including mentions of 'pneumonia', 'community acquired pneumonia', or the ICD-10 code J18, within the patient record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'Absent' if no mention of a pneumonia diagnosis is found in the clinical documentation.
definition.name: pneumonia_diagnosis

definition.description: Presence of abnormal contrast enhancement in the posterior fossa.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether abnormal contrast enhancement is identified in the posterior fossa (including the cerebellar hemispheres and brainstem) from post-contrast T1-weighted imaging reports.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the posterior fossa is not mentioned, if contrast was not administered, or if the report is ambiguous regarding enhancement in this region.
definition.name: posterior_fossa_enhancement

definition.description: Presence of mass effect within the posterior fossa.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify whether the imaging report indicates the presence or absence of mass effect in the posterior fossa (including the cerebellum and brainstem). Explicit statements such as 'no mass effect' map to 'Absent', while statements of mass effect or associated compressive findings map to 'Present'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the posterior fossa is not mentioned or if the presence/absence of mass effect is not documented.
definition.name: posterior_fossa_mass_effect

definition.description: Indication of whether the patient has a history of radiation therapy prior to the current clinical assessment.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient has received any form of radiation therapy (e.g., palliative thoracic radiation, whole-brain radiation, stereotactic radiosurgery/SRS, external beam radiation therapy/EBRT) from the patient's past medical history, oncology consultation notes, or review of systems.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the medical record is silent on radiation therapy or is ambiguous; represent as 'No' if previous radiation therapy is explicitly denied.
definition.name: previous_radiation_therapy

definition.description: The anatomical location of the primary lung tumor.
definition.measurement_definition: The specific lobe of the lung where the primary tumor is located, extracted from radiology reports (e.g., CT, PET/CT) or surgical/biopsy pathology reports.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'Unspecified' if the lobe is not documented or the location is ambiguous.
definition.name: primary_tumor_location

definition.description: The descriptive morphological characteristic of the primary tumor's shape or margins.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the descriptive term characterizing the primary tumor's morphology (e.g., 'spiculated', 'lobulated', 'irregular', 'smooth', 'circumscribed') from the radiology or pathology reports in the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no morphological description is provided in the record.
definition.name: primary_tumor_morphology

definition.description: The greatest dimension of the primary lung tumor.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the maximum diameter of the primary lung tumor from the pretreatment record, typically found in radiology reports (CT, PET/CT) or surgical pathology reports, measured in centimeters.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no numeric tumor size is documented or if the documentation is ambiguous.
definition.name: primary_tumor_size

definition.description: Whether the patient has a history of receiving platinum-based chemotherapy prior to the current treatment context.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient has received chemotherapy containing a platinum agent (e.g., cisplatin, carboplatin, oxaliplatin) from the past medical history, oncology progress notes, or discharge summaries.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the record does not mention chemotherapy or the specific agents used.
definition.name: prior_platinum_chemotherapy

definition.description: The name or description of the systemic therapy regimen administered to the patient prior to the current assessment.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the specific name of the chemotherapy or immunotherapy regimen(s) mentioned in the patient's history. This includes specific drug combinations (e.g., 'cisplatin/vinorelbine'), single agents (e.g., 'docetaxel'), or general clinical descriptions (e.g., 'platinum-free doublet').
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'Not documented' if no prior systemic treatment regimen is mentioned in the record.
definition.name: prior_treatment_regimen

definition.description: Patient-reported severity of pain according to the PRO-CTCAE instrument.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical grade (0, 1, 2, 3, or 4) for pain severity from the PRO-CTCAE instrument section of the patient record. If reported as 'X/4', extract 'X'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the PRO-CTCAE pain severity is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: pro_ctcae_pain_severity

definition.description: Presence of symptoms triggered by physical exertion that have worsened in frequency or severity over time.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient record indicates symptoms (e.g., dyspnea, angina, or fatigue) that occur during exertion and are described as progressive or worsening.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if documentation of exertional symptoms or their progression is absent or ambiguous.
definition.name: progressive_exertional_symptoms

definition.description: Patient use of proton pump inhibitor (PPI) medication prior to treatment.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient is documented as taking a proton pump inhibitor (e.g., omeprazole, pantoprazole, lansoprazole, esomeprazole, rabeprazole) from the medication list or clinical history.
definition.missing_value_rule: If PPI use is not documented or the documentation is ambiguous, represent as null.
definition.name: proton_pump_inhibitor_use

definition.description: A binary indicator of whether psychiatric symptoms are documented in the patient's pretreatment record.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the presence or absence of any documented psychiatric symptoms or diagnoses from the pretreatment medical records.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if there is no documentation or the documentation is ambiguous regarding the presence of psychiatric symptoms.
definition.name: psychiatric_symptom_presence

definition.description: Presence of a documented pulmonary condition.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient record contains a diagnosis or a clinical finding indicating a pulmonary condition (e.g., COPD, asthma, pulmonary fibrosis, or other bilateral pulmonary pathologies).
definition.missing_value_rule: If no pulmonary condition is documented or the information is ambiguous, it is represented as 'Absent'.
definition.name: pulmonary_condition

definition.description: The qualitative status of pulmonary function tests (PFTs).
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the reported status of pulmonary function tests from the clinical record, categorized as 'Normal' or 'Abnormal'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if PFT status is not documented.
definition.name: pulmonary_function_test_status

definition.description: Presence of pulmonary lesions in the pretreatment clinical records.
definition.measurement_definition: Determine if pulmonary lesions are reported as present in the patient's pretreatment documentation.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if there is no mention of pulmonary lesions or if the documentation is too ambiguous to determine presence.
definition.name: pulmonary_lesion_presence

definition.description: Presence of pulmonary nodules in the lungs.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether pulmonary nodules are reported in the pretreatment imaging (typically CT chest). A report of 'no pulmonary nodules' or 'no new pulmonary nodules' indicates 'absent'. The mention of any pulmonary nodule, regardless of size or novelty, indicates 'present'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no imaging reports are available or if pulmonary nodules are not mentioned.
definition.name: pulmonary_nodules_presence

definition.description: The response of the pupils to light stimulation
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the pupils are documented as reactive or non-reactive to light from the neurological or physical examination section of the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if pupil reactivity is not documented or is described ambiguously.
definition.name: pupil_reactivity

definition.description: Patient-reported score of physical function from the EORTC QLQ-C30 questionnaire.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric value for Physical Function (often denoted as Physical or Physical Function) from the EORTC QLQ-C30 instrument.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the Physical Function score is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: qlq_c30_physical_function

definition.description: Patient-reported role functioning score from the EORTC QLQ-C30 quality of life instrument.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical value for 'Role Function' (or 'Role') from the EORTC QLQ-C30 assessment. If the score is reported as a fraction (e.g., '70/100'), extract the numerator.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the EORTC QLQ-C30 Role Function score is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: qlq_c30_role_function

definition.description: Presence of a history of radiation therapy prior to the current treatment phase.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify any documentation indicating the patient has undergone radiation therapy, including external-beam radiation therapy (EBRT), stereotactic body radiation therapy (SBRT), or general radiation therapy procedures.
definition.missing_value_rule: If radiation therapy is not mentioned, is explicitly documented as unknown, or is ambiguous, it is represented as 'No'.
definition.name: radiation_therapy_history

definition.description: The total number of radiation therapy sessions received by the patient prior to the baseline measurement.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric count of radiation therapy treatments or sessions documented in the patient's pretreatment clinical records.
definition.missing_value_rule: If no numeric count of radiation therapy sessions is documented or the information is ambiguous, represent as null.
definition.name: radiation_therapy_session_count

definition.description: History of radiosurgery or stereotactic radiosurgery (SRS) prior to the pretreatment record.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the patient record contains any mention of prior radiosurgery or stereotactic radiosurgery (SRS), including terms such as 'post-srs' or specific SRS dosing (e.g., 'srs 12 gy').
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'No' if there is no mention of radiosurgery; represent as null if the documentation specifically suggests the history is unknown or ambiguous.
definition.name: radiosurgery_history

definition.description: The patient's ability to touch their toes, reflecting lower back and hamstring range of motion.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient is documented as able or unable to touch their toes during a physical examination.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the ability to touch toes is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: range_of_motion_touch_toes

definition.description: Binary indicator of whether a rash is present in the patient's clinical record.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify whether the pretreatment records explicitly mention the presence of a rash or rashes.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'Absent' if no mention of a rash is found or if the documentation is ambiguous.
definition.name: rash_presence

definition.description: Presence of rash or pruritus
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient's pretreatment record indicates the presence of a skin rash or pruritus (itching).
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if there is no mention of rash or pruritus in the patient record.
definition.name: rash_pruritus_presence

definition.description: Serum creatinine level used as a proxy for renal function status.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical value of serum creatinine from the pretreatment record, typically found within a renal panel.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if serum creatinine is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: renal_function_status

definition.description: The number of breaths taken by the patient per minute.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric value for respiratory rate (RR) from the vital signs section of the pretreatment clinical record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the respiratory rate is not documented or is provided only as a non-numeric description.
definition.name: respiratory_rate

definition.description: Presence of restricted diffusion on Diffusion Weighted Imaging (DWI) and Apparent Diffusion Coefficient (ADC) maps.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the presence or absence of restricted diffusion from the radiology report's DWI/ADC findings section. 'No areas of restricted diffusion' maps to 'Absent'; mentions of restricted diffusion as a finding map to 'Present'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if DWI/ADC imaging was not performed or if restricted diffusion is not mentioned.
definition.name: restricted_diffusion_on_dwi_adc

definition.description: Presence or absence of a RET gene rearrangement or fusion in the tumor sample.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the status of RET gene rearrangement/fusion from the molecular pathology or next-generation sequencing (NGS) results.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the RET rearrangement status is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: ret_rearrangement_status

definition.description: Presence of enlarged lymph nodes in the retroperitoneal region.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the pretreatment clinical records or imaging reports indicate the presence of retroperitoneal lymphadenopathy.
definition.missing_value_rule: If the records do not mention retroperitoneal lymph nodes or their status, represent as null.
definition.name: retroperitoneal_lymphadenopathy_presence

definition.description: The mutation or rearrangement status of the ROS1 gene.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the ROS1 status from genomic or pathology reports, identifying whether the gene is reported as 'wild type' or contains a mutation or rearrangement.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if ROS1 status is not documented or cannot be determined from the available text.
definition.name: ros1_mutation_status

definition.description: Whether a ROS1 gene rearrangement (fusion) is present in the tumor tissue.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the result of ROS1 rearrangement testing from pathology, immunohistochemistry (IHC), or molecular reports (e.g., NGS, FISH). Reports stating 'negative', 'no rearrangement detected', 'wild-type', or 'not detected' are mapped to Negative; reports stating 'positive' or 'rearrangement detected' are mapped to Positive.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if ROS1 status is not documented or the results are ambiguous.
definition.name: ros1_rearrangement_status

definition.description: Patient's status regarding Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) infection.
definition.measurement_definition: Determine if there is a laboratory test result or clinical diagnosis indicating an active or recent RSV infection in the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no RSV testing or diagnostic documentation is present.
definition.name: rsv_infection_status

definition.description: Presence of metastatic disease in the scapula.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the pretreatment record indicates the presence of metastasis in the scapula (e.g., 'known scapular metastasis', 'scapular metastasis').
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the documentation is absent or does not specify the presence or absence of scapular metastasis.
definition.name: scapular_metastasis

definition.description: The concentration of albumin in the patient's serum.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical value for serum albumin from the pretreatment laboratory records, typically reported as part of a Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP).
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the value is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: serum_albumin

definition.description: The concentration of bicarbonate in the patient's serum, typically measured as part of a Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP).
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the serum bicarbonate level, typically listed as CO2 or HCO3 in the laboratory data section of the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the value is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: serum_bicarbonate

definition.description: The concentration of calcium in the patient's serum.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the most recent numeric value for serum calcium measured in mg/dL from the pretreatment clinical record.
definition.missing_value_rule: If serum calcium is not documented or is ambiguous, return null.
definition.name: serum_calcium

definition.description: The concentration of chloride ions in the patient's serum.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical value for serum chloride (often abbreviated as 'Cl') from the pretreatment laboratory records, typically found within a Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP).
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the serum chloride measurement is missing or ambiguous.
definition.name: serum_chloride

definition.description: The concentration of creatinine in the blood serum, used as a primary indicator of renal function.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical value for serum creatinine (often abbreviated as Cr or Creatinine) from the patient's laboratory results, typically reported within a Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP).
definition.missing_value_rule: If serum creatinine is not documented or is ambiguously reported, represent the value as null.
definition.name: serum_creatinine

definition.description: The concentration of potassium in the patient's serum.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric value of serum potassium, typically listed as 'K' or 'Potassium' within a Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP) or laboratory results section.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the value is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: serum_potassium

definition.description: The concentration of sodium ions in the patient's blood serum.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric value for serum sodium (commonly abbreviated as 'Na') from the Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP) or a basic electrolyte panel in the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if serum sodium is not documented or the value is ambiguous.
definition.name: serum_sodium

definition.description: Biological sex of the patient.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the patient's biological sex from the pretreatment medical record, typically found in the patient demographics, header, or pathology report patient information section.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if not documented or ambiguous.
definition.name: sex

definition.description: Presence of a skeletal compression fracture.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether a skeletal compression fracture is explicitly documented in the pretreatment clinical or imaging records.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represented as Absent if no mention of a skeletal compression fracture is found in the record.
definition.name: skeletal_compression_fracture

definition.description: Presence of lytic or sclerotic lesions at the skull base.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify whether the imaging report explicitly states the presence or absence of lytic or sclerotic lesions in the skull base or calvarium.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the skull base is not mentioned or if there is no statement regarding lytic or sclerotic lesions.
definition.name: skull_base_lytic_sclerotic_lesions

definition.description: The date the patient stopped smoking.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the date on which the patient ceased tobacco use as documented in the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the date is not documented or if the patient is currently smoking.
definition.name: smoking_abstinence_date

definition.description: The length of time since the patient stopped smoking.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the duration since the patient ceased smoking, categorized as <= 5 years, 5-10 years, or > 10 years, as documented in the pretreatment records.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if smoking cessation duration is not documented or the patient is a current smoker.
definition.name: smoking_cessation_duration

definition.description: The patient's lifetime tobacco use status.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the patient's smoking status from the social history, past medical history, or review of systems. Identify whether the patient has never used tobacco, used tobacco in the past but has since quit, or is currently using tobacco.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'Unknown' if the documentation is absent, ambiguous, or contradictory without a clear timeline.
definition.name: smoking_status

definition.description: The mutation status of the STK11 gene, specifically whether a pathogenic alteration or loss of function is present.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the STK11 genomic status from molecular pathology or next-generation sequencing (NGS) reports. Any report of a pathogenic mutation, 'loss', 'loss-of-function', or 'homozygous deletion' is mapped to 'Mutated'. Reports of 'wild-type' or 'no pathogenic variants detected' are mapped to 'Wild-type'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if STK11 status is not documented or explicitly listed as unknown.
definition.name: stk11_mutation_status

definition.description: Presence of subdural hemorrhage
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the presence or absence of subdural hemorrhage from pretreatment imaging reports or clinical documentation. Mark as 'present' if a subdural hemorrhage or subdural hematoma is identified; mark as 'absent' if the report explicitly states no subdural hemorrhage is present.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the records do not mention the presence or absence of subdural hemorrhage.
definition.name: subdural_hemorrhage

definition.description: Qualitative assessment of the cerebral sulci and cisterns on neuroimaging.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the description of the cerebral sulci and cisterns from the imaging report. Assign 'unremarkable' for descriptors indicating a normal appearance (e.g., 'unremarkable', 'normal', 'within normal limits') and 'abnormal' for any description of pathology (e.g., 'effaced', 'widened', 'prominent', 'narrowed').
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the documentation is absent or does not explicitly describe the appearance of the sulci and cisterns.
definition.name: sulci_and_cisterns_appearance

definition.description: A binary indicator of whether the surgical resection margins are free of tumor cells.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the status of the surgical resection margins from the pathology report or surgical summary. 'Negative' or 'free of tumor' (often corresponding to R0 resection) should be mapped to 'Negative'; 'Positive' or 'involved' (corresponding to R1 or R2 resection) should be mapped to 'Positive'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if surgical margin status is not documented or is explicitly stated as unknown.
definition.name: surgical_margin_status

definition.description: Whether the patient underwent a surgical procedure.
definition.measurement_definition: Determine if any surgical intervention (e.g., lobectomy, lymph node dissection) is documented in the patient's pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'No' if no surgical procedure is documented or if the documentation is ambiguous.
definition.name: surgical_procedure

definition.description: The pressure in the patient's arteries during the contraction of the heart ventricle.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the first numeric value (the systolic component) from the blood pressure reading (e.g., from '128/74 mmHg', extract '128') found in the physical examination or vital signs section of the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if systolic blood pressure is not documented or if the documentation is too ambiguous to extract a numeric value.
definition.name: systolic_blood_pressure

definition.description: The T (primary tumor) component of the TNM staging system for lung cancer, describing the size and extent of the primary tumor.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the T-stage value from the TNM classification string (e.g., 'T3' from 'T3N2M1' or 'pT2a' from 'pT2aN2'). Remove prefixes such as 'p' (pathological) or 'c' (clinical) to isolate the scalar T-category.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the T-stage is not explicitly documented or is listed as TX.
definition.name: t_stage

definition.description: Indicator of whether the patient has received targeted therapy prior to the current treatment phase.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if there is any documented evidence in the pretreatment record of the patient being prescribed or receiving targeted therapy agents.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the medical record contains no mention of targeted therapy or the information is too ambiguous to determine use.
definition.name: targeted_therapy_use

definition.description: Whether Next Generation Sequencing (NGS) was performed on the patient prior to treatment.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if any clinical documentation, laboratory report, or pathology note indicates that Next Generation Sequencing (NGS) was performed.
definition.missing_value_rule: If no mention of NGS is found or the documentation is ambiguous, represent as missing.
definition.name: test_ngs_performed

definition.description: Presence of thyromegaly (enlarged thyroid gland) documented in the patient record.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the patient record explicitly mentions thyromegaly or an enlarged thyroid gland during physical examination or imaging.
definition.missing_value_rule: If thyromegaly is not mentioned or explicitly documented as absent, it should be represented as 'Absent'.
definition.name: thyromegaly_presence

definition.description: Indicates whether the patient was using tiotropium prior to the start of treatment.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if tiotropium is listed in the patient's medication records, prescriptions, or mentioned as a current medication in clinical notes.
definition.missing_value_rule: If no documentation of tiotropium use is present or if the documentation is ambiguous, represent as 'No'.
definition.name: tiotropium_use

definition.description: Presence of abnormal tissue thickening.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the clinical record indicates the presence of tissue thickening.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the documentation does not mention tissue thickening or is ambiguous.
definition.name: tissue_thickening

definition.description: Indicates whether the patient is using tyrosine kinase inhibitor (TKI) therapy.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the patient is prescribed or receiving tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKIs), including specific agents such as osimertinib or broader categories like EGFR TKIs, in the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: If there is no documentation of TKI therapy or its absence, the value is represented as null.
definition.name: tki_therapy_use

definition.description: Total cumulative tobacco smoking exposure measured in pack-years.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the total number of pack-years of smoking history from the patient's social or medical history. If the patient is explicitly documented as a 'never smoker', the value is 0.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if smoking status is not mentioned, or if the patient is identified as a current or former smoker but no numeric pack-year value is provided.
definition.name: tobacco_smoking_history

definition.description: The total concentration of bilirubin in the blood serum.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric value for total bilirubin from the laboratory data, typically located within the Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP) or a liver function panel.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the value is not documented, is ambiguous, or cannot be converted to a numeric value.
definition.name: total_bilirubin

definition.description: The mutation status of the TP53 gene in tumor tissue.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the TP53 mutation status from molecular pathology or next-generation sequencing (NGS) reports. Assign 'Mutant' if a pathogenic or likely pathogenic mutation is identified (e.g., 'TP53 mutation', 'missense mutation', or specific variants like R273C, R273H, R175H). Assign 'Wild-type' if the report explicitly states 'Wild-type' or 'no pathogenic variants detected'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if TP53 status is not documented, not tested, or the results are ambiguous.
definition.name: tp53_mutation_status

definition.description: Detection status of the TP53 R273H mutation in tumor tissue.
definition.measurement_definition: Determine if the TP53 R273H mutation is identified as present, detected, or positive in molecular profiling or genomic reports (e.g., NGS).
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no molecular profiling is documented or if the TP53 status is mentioned without specifying the R273H variant.
definition.name: tp53_r273h_mutation_status

definition.description: A numeric prognostic score (TPS) recorded in the patient's pretreatment clinical documentation.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric value explicitly labeled as the TPS score from the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent missing or ambiguous documentation as null.
definition.name: tps_score

definition.description: Presence of cerebrospinal fluid seepage across the ventricular ependymal lining into the surrounding brain parenchyma.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the neuroimaging report explicitly mentions 'transependymal flow' or 'periventricular signal abnormality' suggestive of CSF seepage. If reported as 'no transependymal flow', the value is Absent; if reported as present or evidence of seepage is noted, the value is Present.
definition.missing_value_rule: If transependymal flow is not mentioned or is ambiguous, record as null.
definition.name: transependymal_flow

definition.description: The duration of the interval between successive treatment cycles.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical number of days between treatment cycles. If the frequency is reported in weeks (e.g., 'every 3 weeks'), convert this value to days (e.g., 21 days).
definition.missing_value_rule: If the treatment cycle frequency is not documented, is ambiguous, or refers only to hourly medication dosing (e.g., q6h), represent as null.
definition.name: treatment_cycle_frequency

definition.description: The primary stated objective for the patient's medical treatment.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the explicit goal of treatment mentioned in the pretreatment record, specifically looking for mentions of functional targets (e.g., ambulation), disease-modifying targets (e.g., preventing progression), or palliative targets (e.g., symptom management).
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no treatment goals are documented.
definition.name: treatment_goals

definition.description: The best overall response to treatment as determined by radiographic or clinical criteria.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the documented response category (e.g., Complete Response, Partial Response, Stable Disease, or Progressive Disease) associated with the most recent evaluation of the treatment's effect on the disease burden.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no specific response category is documented.
definition.name: treatment_response

definition.description: TTF-1 (Thyroid Transcription Factor-1) protein expression in lung tumor cells as determined by immunohistochemistry.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the result of the TTF-1 immunohistochemistry stain from the pathology or ancillary studies section of the patient record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if TTF-1 testing was not performed, the result is not documented, or the documentation is ambiguous.
definition.name: ttf1_expression

definition.description: Detection of tumor cells within a clinical sample.
definition.measurement_definition: Review pathology or cytology reports for an explicit statement regarding the presence or absence of tumor cells.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the record does not mention tumor cell presence or if the documentation is ambiguous.
definition.name: tumor_cell_presence

definition.description: The histologic grade of the tumor reflecting the degree to which tumor cells resemble their normal counterparts.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the descriptive grade of tumor differentiation (e.g., well, moderately, or poorly differentiated) from the pathology or biopsy reports.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the differentiation grade is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: tumor_differentiation

definition.description: Presence or absence of tumor invasion into surrounding tissues, vessels, or nerves.
